WITH inv AS (
  SELECT 
    i.inv_id,
    i.inv_dt,
    i.curr_cd,
    i.inv_tot_amt,
    COALESCE(fx.fx_rt, 1.0) AS fx_rt,
    i.inv_tot_amt * COALESCE(fx.fx_rt, 1.0) AS amt_usd
  FROM bil_cust_inv i
  LEFT JOIN ref_fx_rate fx
    ON fx.from_curr_cd = i.curr_cd
    AND fx.to_curr_cd = 'USD'
    AND fx.eff_mo_dt = DATE_TRUNC(i.inv_dt, MONTH)
  WHERE i.inv_dt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
),
cr AS (
  SELECT 
    c.cr_memo_id,
    c.cr_dt,
    c.curr_cd,
    c.cr_amt,
    COALESCE(fx.fx_rt, 1.0) AS fx_rt,
    c.cr_amt * COALESCE(fx.fx_rt, 1.0) AS amt_usd
  FROM bil_cr_memo c
  LEFT JOIN ref_fx_rate fx
    ON fx.from_curr_cd = c.curr_cd
    AND fx.to_curr_cd = 'USD'
    AND fx.eff_mo_dt = DATE_TRUNC(c.cr_dt, MONTH)
  WHERE c.cr_dt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
),
canc AS (
  SELECT 
    f.canc_fee_id,
    f.fee_dt,
    f.curr_cd,
    f.cust_fee_amt,
    COALESCE(fx.fx_rt, 1.0) AS fx_rt,
    f.cust_fee_amt * COALESCE(fx.fx_rt, 1.0) AS amt_usd
  FROM bil_canc_fee f
  LEFT JOIN ref_fx_rate fx
    ON fx.from_curr_cd = f.curr_cd
    AND fx.to_curr_cd = 'USD'
    AND fx.eff_mo_dt = DATE_TRUNC(f.fee_dt, MONTH)
  WHERE f.fee_dt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT SUM(amt_usd) FROM inv) AS inv_tot,
  (SELECT SUM(amt_usd) FROM cr) AS cr_tot,
  (SELECT SUM(amt_usd) FROM canc) AS canc_tot,
  (SELECT SUM(amt_usd) FROM inv) - (SELECT SUM(amt_usd) FROM cr) + (SELECT SUM(amt_usd) FROM canc) AS net_revenue

      WHEN i.curr_cd = 'USD' THEN i.inv_tot_amt

LEFT JOIN ref_fx_rate fx 
  ON fx.from_curr_cd = i.curr_cd

  AND fx.eff_mo_dt = DATE_TRUNC(i.inv_dt, MONTH)
WHERE i.inv_dt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 5

In September 2026, a total of 1,097 loads were delivered. Under Tessaway Freight's billing rules, a delivered load requires a signed proof of delivery (POD) on file to be billable and invoiced. Of the loads delivered in September 2026, 142 are missing a signed proof of delivery and remain unbillable.

ANSWER: 142

queries.sql:
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as total_rows
FROM tms_load_hdr
WHERE NOT COALESCE(test_flg, FALSE)
  AND NOT COALESCE(void_flg, FALSE)
  AND load_stat_cd = 'DLVD'
SELECT DISTINCT stop_typ_cd FROM tms_stop

WITH last_dl_stop AS (
  SELECT 
    load_id,
    stop_seq,
    arr_ts,
    tz_nm,
    DATE(arr_ts, tz_nm) AS dlvr_dt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY load_id ORDER BY stop_seq DESC) as rn
  FROM tms_stop
  WHERE stop_typ_cd = 'DL'
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as dlvd_sep,
  COUNTIF(has_signed_pod) as billable_sep,
  COUNTIF(NOT has_signed_pod) as not_billable_sep
FROM (
  SELECT 
    h.load_id,
    s.dlvr_dt,
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM bil_pod_doc p 
      WHERE p.load_id = h.load_id AND p.signed_flg IS TRUE
    ) AS has_signed_pod
  FROM tms_load_hdr h
  JOIN last_dl_stop s ON h.load_id = s.load_id AND s.rn = 1
  WHERE NOT COALESCE(h.test_flg, FALSE)
    AND NOT COALESCE(h.void_flg, FALSE)
    AND h.load_stat_cd = 'DLVD'
    AND s.dlvr_dt BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
)

For September 2026 deliveries, the customer portal recorded 1,097 delivered shipments, of which 1,004 were delivered on or before the customer's requested delivery date. This corresponds to a portal on-time delivery rate of 91.52%.

ANSWER: 91.52

queries.sql:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_rows,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN on_time_ind = 'Y' THEN 1 END) as on_time_rows,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN on_time_ind = 'N' THEN 1 END) as not_on_time_rows,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN actl_dlvr_dt <= req_dlvr_dt THEN 1 END) as dt_on_time,
  100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN on_time_ind = 'Y' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) as rate_ind,
  100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN actl_dlvr_dt <= req_dlvr_dt THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) as rate_calc
FROM ptl_shpmt
WHERE actl_dlvr_dt BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
SELECT * FROM ptl_shpmt LIMIT 5

matches.label: portal on-time
matches.definition: The customer portal shows a shipment as on time when it was delivered on or before the date the customer requested.
rules: It is the right answer only when the question is about what customers see in the portal. It is not the official on-time rate.
The portal compares dates, not appointment times, and knows nothing about who caused a delay.

matches.label: on-time
matches.definition: Tessaway's official on-time delivery rate is the one its customer contracts define.
rules: A load is on time when the truck arrives at the final delivery stop at or before the end of the appointment window. Arriving early is on time.
A load that arrived late and has a delay the shipper caused (a DLAY status event with reason SHPR) is left out of the measure, top and bottom. It is neither on time nor late.
A load the shipper delayed that still arrived inside its window counts as on time.
Arrival and appointment are compared on the same clock: local time at the facility.
The rate is on-time loads divided by measured loads, over delivered loads.

Two other meanings are in use and are not the official rate: operations watches arrival inside the appointment window for every delivered load, shipper-caused or not; and the customer portal uses its own rule.
warehouse_source: tms_stop: arr_ts, appt_end_lcl, tz_nm at the final delivery stop; tms_stat_evt: evt_cd = 'DLAY' with rsn_cd = 'SHPR'

matches.label: currency
matches.definition: Tessaway reports in US dollars.
rules: Convert at the monthly rate in ref_fx_rate for the month of the document date: the invoice date, the credit date or the fee date.
Costs on an invoiced load convert at the invoice month's rate.
Most cross-border loads are rated, invoiced and paid in Canadian dollars. Every amount on such a load carries curr_cd = 'CAD' and is stored unconverted.
warehouse_source: curr_cd on every amount; ref_fx_rate holds the monthly rate

matches.label: local time
matches.definition: Operational dates are local: a delivery happened on the calendar day it was at the destination.
rules: A truck that arrives in the evening at its destination arrived on that local calendar day, although the stored UTC instant may fall on the next day.
Appointment times are compared with arrival times only after putting both on the same clock.
Booking dates use the UTC date of crt_ts. Financial dates (inv_dt, cr_dt, fee_dt) are plain dates and need no conversion.
Every *_lcl column is a wall-clock time at the facility, with no zone attached. The zone is in tz_nm on the stop and on the facility.
Every *_ts column is an instant stored in UTC.

answer_text:
Under Tessaway's official definition (the contractually defined on-time delivery rate), a load is on time if it arrives at the final delivery stop at or before the end of the appointment window based on the facility's local time. Loads that arrived late due to a shipper-caused delay are excluded from both the numerator and denominator.

In September 2026 (2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30):
- **Delivered loads:** 1,097
- **Measured loads:** 1,059 (excluding 38 late deliveries caused by the shipper)
- **On-time loads:** 926
- **Late deliveries:** 133

$$\text{On-Time Delivery Rate} = \frac{926}{1,059} \times 100 \approx 87.4409820585458\%$$

ANSWER: 87.4409820585458

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_dlvd,
  COUNTIF(arr_ts <= TIMESTAMP(appt_end_lcl, tz_nm)) as on_time,
  COUNTIF(arr_ts > TIMESTAMP(appt_end_lcl, tz_nm)) as late
FROM (
  SELECT 
    h.load_id,
    s.arr_ts,
    s.appt_end_lcl,
    s.tz_nm,
    DATE(s.arr_ts, s.tz_nm) as dlvr_dt
  FROM tms_load_hdr h
  JOIN tms_stop s ON h.load_id = s.load_id
  WHERE s.stop_typ_cd = 'DLVR'
    AND h.load_stat_cd = 'DLVD'
    AND NOT COALESCE(h.test_flg, FALSE)
    AND NOT COALESCE(h.void_flg, FALSE)
)
WHERE dlvr_dt BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
SELECT stop_typ_cd, count(*) FROM tms_stop GROUP BY 1
SELECT (926.0 / 1059.0) * 100 as rate, CAST(926 as NUMERIC) / CAST(1059 as NUMERIC) * 100 as num_rate

matches.label: on-time
matches.definition: Tessaway's official on-time delivery rate is the one its customer contracts define.
rules: A load is on time when the truck arrives at the final delivery stop at or before the end of the appointment window. Arriving early is on time.
A load that arrived late and has a delay the shipper caused (a DLAY status event with reason SHPR) is left out of the measure, top and bottom. It is neither on time nor late.
A load the shipper delayed that still arrived inside its window counts as on time.
Arrival and appointment are compared on the same clock: local time at the facility.
The rate is on-time loads divided by measured loads, over delivered loads.

Two other meanings are in use and are not the official rate: operations watches arrival inside the appointment window for every delivered load, shipper-caused or not; and the customer portal uses its own rule.

WITH inv AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.curr_cd = 'USD' THEN i.inv_tot_amt ELSE i.inv_tot_amt * fx.fx_rt END) AS inv_rev
  FROM bil_cust_inv i
  LEFT JOIN ref_fx_rate fx
    ON fx.from_curr_cd = i.curr_cd
   AND fx.to_curr_cd = 'USD'
   AND fx.eff_mo_dt = DATE_TRUNC(i.inv_dt, MONTH)
  WHERE i.inv_dt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
),
cr AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.curr_cd = 'USD' THEN c.cr_amt ELSE c.cr_amt * fx.fx_rt END) AS cr_amt
  FROM bil_cr_memo c
  LEFT JOIN ref_fx_rate fx
    ON fx.from_curr_cd = c.curr_cd
   AND fx.to_curr_cd = 'USD'
   AND fx.eff_mo_dt = DATE_TRUNC(c.cr_dt, MONTH)
  WHERE c.cr_dt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
),
canc AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.curr_cd = 'USD' THEN f.cust_fee_amt ELSE f.cust_fee_amt * fx.fx_rt END) AS canc_rev
  FROM bil_canc_fee f
  LEFT JOIN ref_fx_rate fx
    ON fx.from_curr_cd = f.curr_cd
   AND fx.to_curr_cd = 'USD'
   AND fx.eff_mo_dt = DATE_TRUNC(f.fee_dt, MONTH)
  WHERE f.fee_dt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
)
SELECT
  inv.inv_rev,
  cr.cr_amt,
  canc.canc_rev,
  inv.inv_rev - cr.cr_amt + canc.canc_rev AS total_revenue
FROM inv CROSS JOIN cr CROSS JOIN canc

answer_text:
To determine the revenue brought in by Northgate Foods (parent account **Northgate Foods Group**, `A10004`) during Q3 2026 (July 1, 2026 – September 30, 2026), we account for:
- Invoiced load totals recognized by invoice date (`bil_cust_inv`)
- Less credit memos recognized by credit date (`bil_cr_memo`)
- Plus canceled-load fees billed to the customer recognized by fee date (`bil_canc_fee`)
- Converted to USD using the monthly exchange rate (`ref_fx_rate`) for Canadian-dollar transactions

### Revenue Breakdown for Q3 2026:
- **USD Invoices:** $1,134,138.73
- **CAD Invoices (converted to USD):** $172,410.913894
- **USD Credit Memos:** -$7,312.06
- **CAD Credit Memos (converted to USD):** -$972.320236
- **USD Canceled-Load Fees:** $1,425.00
- **Total Revenue:** $1,299,690.263658 (or $1,299,690.26 rounded to the nearest cent)

ANSWER: 1299690.263658

queries.sql:
SELECT acct_id, acct_nm, acct_typ_cd, prnt_acct_id, seg_cd, ctry_cd, actv_flg
FROM mdm_cust_acct
WHERE acct_id = 'A10004' OR prnt_acct_id = 'A10004' OR acct_nm LIKE '%Northgate%'
SELECT * FROM ref_fx_rate WHERE eff_mo_dt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-01'

WITH inv AS (
  SELECT 
    i.inv_tot_amt * COALESCE(fx.fx_rt, 1.0) AS rev_usd
  FROM bil_cust_inv i
  JOIN tms_load_hdr h ON i.load_id = h.load_id
  JOIN mdm_cust_acct s ON h.shpr_acct_id = s.acct_id
  LEFT JOIN ref_fx_rate fx 
    ON fx.eff_mo_dt = DATE_TRUNC(i.inv_dt, MONTH) 
   AND fx.from_curr_cd = i.curr_cd 
   AND fx.to_curr_cd = 'USD'
  WHERE s.prnt_acct_id = 'A10004'
    AND i.inv_dt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
),
cr AS (
  SELECT 
    -1 * c.cr_amt * COALESCE(fx.fx_rt, 1.0) AS rev_usd
  FROM bil_cr_memo c
  JOIN tms_load_hdr h ON c.load_id = h.load_id
  JOIN mdm_cust_acct s ON h.shpr_acct_id = s.acct_id
  LEFT JOIN ref_fx_rate fx 
    ON fx.eff_mo_dt = DATE_TRUNC(c.cr_dt, MONTH) 
   AND fx.from_curr_cd = c.curr_cd 
   AND fx.to_curr_cd = 'USD'
  WHERE s.prnt_acct_id = 'A10004'
    AND c.cr_dt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
),
canc AS (
  SELECT 
    f.cust_fee_amt * COALESCE(fx.fx_rt, 1.0) AS rev_usd
  FROM bil_canc_fee f
  JOIN tms_load_hdr h ON f.load_id = h.load_id
  JOIN mdm_cust_acct s ON h.shpr_acct_id = s.acct_id
  LEFT JOIN ref_fx_rate fx 
    ON fx.eff_mo_dt = DATE_TRUNC(f.fee_dt, MONTH) 
   AND fx.from_curr_cd = f.curr_cd 
   AND fx.to_curr_cd = 'USD'
  WHERE s.prnt_acct_id = 'A10004'
    AND f.fee_dt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
)
SELECT SUM(rev_usd) FROM (
  SELECT * FROM inv
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM cr
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM canc
)

   AND fx.to_curr_cd = 'USD'

  JOIN mdm_cust_acct s ON h.shpr_acct_id = s.acct_id
  LEFT JOIN ref_fx_rate fx

answer_text:
According to Tessaway Freight's official on-time performance definitions, a delivered load is counted as late when it arrives at the final delivery stop after the end of the appointment window on the facility's local clock, excluding late deliveries caused by shipper delays. 

In September 2026, out of 1,097 total delivered loads:
- **926** loads arrived on time.
- **38** loads arrived after their appointment window but were excluded due to shipper-caused delays.
- **133** loads were officially classified as late deliveries.

ANSWER: 133

queries.sql:
WITH final_stops AS (
  SELECT
    s.load_id,
    s.arr_ts,
    s.appt_end_lcl,
    s.tz_nm,
    DATETIME(s.arr_ts, s.tz_nm) AS arr_lcl,
    DATE(DATETIME(s.arr_ts, s.tz_nm)) AS dlvr_dt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.load_id ORDER BY s.stop_seq DESC) AS rn
  FROM tms_stop s
  WHERE s.stop_typ_cd = 'DEL'
),
delivered AS (
  SELECT
    h.load_id,
    fs.dlvr_dt,
    CASE WHEN fs.arr_lcl <= fs.appt_end_lcl THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS on_time,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM tms_stat_evt e 
      WHERE e.load_id = h.load_id AND e.evt_cd = 'DLAY' AND e.rsn_cd = 'SHPR'
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS shipper_delayed
  FROM tms_load_hdr h
  JOIN final_stops fs ON h.load_id = fs.load_id AND fs.rn = 1
  WHERE h.test_flg = FALSE AND h.void_flg = FALSE
    AND h.load_stat_cd = 'DELIVERED'
    AND fs.arr_ts IS NOT NULL
    AND fs.dlvr_dt BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_delivered,
  SUM(on_time) AS on_time_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN on_time = 0 AND shipper_delayed = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS late_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN on_time = 0 AND shipper_delayed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS late_shipper_delayed
FROM delivered

matches.label: local time
matches.definition: Operational dates are local: a delivery happened on the calendar day it was at the destination.
rules: A truck that arrives in the evening at its destination arrived on that local calendar day, although the stored UTC instant may fall on the next day.
Appointment times are compared with arrival times only after putting both on the same clock.
Booking dates use the UTC date of crt_ts. Financial dates (inv_dt, cr_dt, fee_dt) are plain dates and need no conversion.
Every *_lcl column is a wall-clock time at the facility, with no zone attached. The zone is in tz_nm on the stop and on the facility.
Every *_ts column is an instant stored in UTC.

all_rules.statement: A customer is a parent account. It rolls up to nothing, and it is neither a shipping site nor a bill-to party.
A load is delivered when the carrier on its final row reports the final delivery: status DLVD. A canceled load does not count as delivered.
A load can be invoiced only when a signed proof of delivery is on file. An unsigned document does not count.
Revenue and loads belong to the parent of the site that shipped.
A load is booked on its first tender: the row that does not point to an earlier row. A re-tender is not a second load.
A load is one shipment, counted once: it has exactly one first tender.
A re-tender points to exactly one earlier tender. That first row keeps status RTND and is never deleted.
A shipping site rolls up to exactly one parent account, which is its customer.
The account on a load is a shipping site, and the account that pays is a bill-to party. Neither is the customer.
Test loads are never billed.
A test load or a voided load is not a load.

    COUNT(*) as cnt,
    SUM(i.inv_tot_amt) as total_inv,

FROM bil_cust_inv i
JOIN tms_load_hdr h ON i.load_id = h.load_id

- **926** loads arrived on time (at or before the end of the appointment window at the final delivery stop).
- **133** loads were late without shipper delays.
- **38** late loads had shipper-caused delays and were excluded from the measurement.

matches.label: on-time
matches.definition: Tessaway's official on-time delivery rate is the one its customer contracts define.
rules: A load is on time when the truck arrives at the final delivery stop at or before the end of the appointment window. Arriving early is on time.
A load that arrived late and has a delay the shipper caused (a DLAY status event with reason SHPR) is left out of the measure, top and bottom. It is neither on time nor late.
A load the shipper delayed that still arrived inside its window counts as on time.
Arrival and appointment are compared on the same clock: local time at the facility.
The rate is on-time loads divided by measured loads, over delivered loads.

Two other meanings are in use and are not the official rate: operations watches arrival inside the appointment window for every delivered load, shipper-caused or not; and the customer portal uses its own rule.

WITH inv AS (
  SELECT 
    i.inv_id,
    i.inv_dt,
    i.curr_cd,
    i.inv_tot_amt,
    COALESCE(fx.fx_rt, 1.0) AS fx_rt,
    i.inv_tot_amt * COALESCE(fx.fx_rt, 1.0) AS amt_usd
  FROM bil_cust_inv i
  LEFT JOIN ref_fx_rate fx
    ON fx.from_curr_cd = i.curr_cd 
   AND fx.to_curr_cd = 'USD'
   AND fx.eff_mo_dt = DATE_TRUNC(i.inv_dt, MONTH)
  WHERE i.inv_dt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
),
cr AS (
  SELECT 
    c.cr_memo_id,
    c.cr_dt,
    c.curr_cd,
    c.cr_amt,
    COALESCE(fx.fx_rt, 1.0) AS fx_rt,
    c.cr_amt * COALESCE(fx.fx_rt, 1.0) AS amt_usd
  FROM bil_cr_memo c
  LEFT JOIN ref_fx_rate fx
    ON fx.from_curr_cd = c.curr_cd 
   AND fx.to_curr_cd = 'USD'
   AND fx.eff_mo_dt = DATE_TRUNC(c.cr_dt, MONTH)
  WHERE c.cr_dt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
),
canc AS (
  SELECT 
    f.canc_fee_id,
    f.fee_dt,
    f.curr_cd,
    f.cust_fee_amt,
    COALESCE(fx.fx_rt, 1.0) AS fx_rt,
    f.cust_fee_amt * COALESCE(fx.fx_rt, 1.0) AS amt_usd
  FROM bil_canc_fee f
  LEFT JOIN ref_fx_rate fx
    ON fx.from_curr_cd = f.curr_cd 
   AND fx.to_curr_cd = 'USD'
   AND fx.eff_mo_dt = DATE_TRUNC(f.fee_dt, MONTH)
  WHERE f.fee_dt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT SUM(amt_usd) FROM inv) AS inv_tot,
  (SELECT SUM(amt_usd) FROM cr) AS cr_tot,

queries.sql:
WITH final_stop AS (
  SELECT
    s.load_id,
    s.appt_end_lcl,
    s.arr_ts,
    s.tz_nm,
    DATETIME(s.arr_ts, s.tz_nm) AS arr_lcl,
    DATE(DATETIME(s.arr_ts, s.tz_nm)) AS dlvr_dt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY s.load_id ORDER BY s.stop_seq DESC) AS rn
  FROM tms_stop s
  WHERE s.stop_typ_cd = 'DEL'
),
shipper_delay AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT load_id
  FROM tms_stat_evt
  WHERE evt_cd = 'DLAY' AND rsn_cd = 'SHPR'
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_delivered,
  COUNTIF(f.arr_lcl <= f.appt_end_lcl) AS on_time,
  COUNTIF(f.arr_lcl > f.appt_end_lcl AND sd.load_id IS NULL) AS late_official,
  COUNTIF(f.arr_lcl > f.appt_end_lcl AND sd.load_id IS NOT NULL) AS late_shipper_delayed,

FROM final_stop f
JOIN tms_load_hdr h ON f.load_id = h.load_id
LEFT JOIN shipper_delay sd ON f.load_id = sd.load_id
WHERE f.rn = 1
  AND (h.test_flg IS NULL OR h.test_flg = FALSE)

matches.label: on-time
matches.definition: Tessaway's official on-time delivery rate is the one its customer contracts define.
rules: A load is on time when the truck arrives at the final delivery stop at or before the end of the appointment window. Arriving early is on time.
A load that arrived late and has a delay the shipper caused (a DLAY status event with reason SHPR) is left out of the measure, top and bottom. It is neither on time nor late.
A load the shipper delayed that still arrived inside its window counts as on time.
Arrival and appointment are compared on the same clock: local time at the facility.
The rate is on-time loads divided by measured loads, over delivered loads.

Two other meanings are in use and are not the official rate: operations watches arrival inside the appointment window for every delivered load, shipper-caused or not; and the customer portal uses its own rule.

matches.label: portal on-time
matches.definition: The customer portal shows a shipment as on time when it was delivered on or before the date the customer requested.
rules: It is the right answer only when the question is about what customers see in the portal. It is not the official on-time rate.
The portal compares dates, not appointment times, and knows nothing about who caused a delay.

matches.label: on-time
matches.definition: Tessaway's official on-time delivery rate is the one its customer contracts define.
rules: A load is on time when the truck arrives at the final delivery stop at or before the end of the appointment window. Arriving early is on time.
A load that arrived late and has a delay the shipper caused (a DLAY status event with reason SHPR) is left out of the measure, top and bottom. It is neither on time nor late.
A load the shipper delayed that still arrived inside its window counts as on time.
Arrival and appointment are compared on the same clock: local time at the facility.
The rate is on-time loads divided by measured loads, over delivered loads.

Two other meanings are in use and are not the official rate: operations watches arrival inside the appointment window for every delivered load, shipper-caused or not; and the customer portal uses its own rule.

matches.definition: Tessaway reports in US dollars.
rules: Convert at the monthly rate in ref_fx_rate for the month of the document date: the invoice date, the credit date or the fee date.
Costs on an invoiced load convert at the invoice month's rate.

matches.label: local time
matches.definition: Operational dates are local: a delivery happened on the calendar day it was at the destination.
rules: A truck that arrives in the evening at its destination arrived on that local calendar day, although the stored UTC instant may fall on the next day.
Appointment times are compared with arrival times only after putting both on the same clock.
Booking dates use the UTC date of crt_ts. Financial dates (inv_dt, cr_dt, fee_dt) are plain dates and need no conversion.
Every *_lcl column is a wall-clock time at the facility, with no zone attached. The zone is in tz_nm on the stop and on the facility.
Every *_ts column is an instant stored in UTC.

all_rules.statement: A customer is a parent account. It rolls up to nothing, and it is neither a shipping site nor a bill-to party.
A load is delivered when the carrier on its final row reports the final delivery: status DLVD. A canceled load does not count as delivered.
A load can be invoiced only when a signed proof of delivery is on file. An unsigned document does not count.
Revenue and loads belong to the parent of the site that shipped.
A load is booked on its first tender: the row that does not point to an earlier row. A re-tender is not a second load.
A load is one shipment, counted once: it has exactly one first tender.
A re-tender points to exactly one earlier tender. That first row keeps status RTND and is never deleted.
A shipping site rolls up to exactly one parent account, which is its customer.
The account on a load is a shipping site, and the account that pays is a bill-to party. Neither is the customer.
Test loads are never billed.
A test load or a voided load is not a load.

answer_text:
To determine the revenue generated from cross-border loads in Q3 2026 (July 1, 2026 through September 30, 2026):

1. **Invoiced Revenue**: Total billed customer invoices on cross-border loads during Q3 2026 amounted to 996,568.96752 USD (converted from CAD at the monthly exchange rates in `ref_fx_rate`).
2. **Credit Memos**: Credit memos issued on cross-border loads during this period totaled 10,360.202107 USD.
3. **Canceled Load Fees**: There were no canceled-load fees for cross-border loads during this period.

Subtracting credit memos from invoiced amounts yields a net revenue of $986,208.765413 (or $986,208.77).

ANSWER: 986208.765413

queries.sql:
SELECT 
  h.xbrdr_flg,
  COUNT(i.inv_id) AS inv_cnt,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.curr_cd = 'USD' THEN i.inv_tot_amt ELSE i.inv_tot_amt * fx.fx_rt END) AS inv_rev
FROM bil_cust_inv i
JOIN tms_load_hdr h ON i.load_id = h.load_id
LEFT JOIN ref_fx_rate fx 
  ON fx.from_curr_cd = i.curr_cd 
  AND fx.to_curr_cd = 'USD' 
  AND fx.eff_mo_dt = DATE_TRUNC(i.inv_dt, MONTH)
WHERE i.inv_dt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY h.xbrdr_flg

SELECT 
  h.xbrdr_flg,
  COUNT(cm.cr_memo_id) AS cr_cnt,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cm.curr_cd = 'USD' THEN cm.cr_amt ELSE cm.cr_amt * fx.fx_rt END) AS cr_amt
FROM bil_cr_memo cm
JOIN tms_load_hdr h ON cm.load_id = h.load_id
LEFT JOIN ref_fx_rate fx 
  ON fx.from_curr_cd = cm.curr_cd 
  AND fx.to_curr_cd = 'USD' 
  AND fx.eff_mo_dt = DATE_TRUNC(cm.cr_dt, MONTH)
WHERE cm.cr_dt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY h.xbrdr_flg

  h.xbrdr_flg,
  COUNT(cf.canc_fee_id) AS fee_cnt,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cf.curr_cd = 'USD' THEN cf.cust_fee_amt ELSE cf.cust_fee_amt * fx.fx_rt END) AS fee_amt
FROM bil_canc_fee cf
JOIN tms_load_hdr h ON cf.load_id = h.load_id
LEFT JOIN ref_fx_rate fx 
  ON fx.from_curr_cd = cf.curr_cd 
  AND fx.to_curr_cd = 'USD'

WHERE cf.fee_dt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'

answer_text:
To determine the revenue generated by Northgate Foods in Q3 2026 (July 1, 2026 to September 30, 2026):

1. **Entity Resolution**: Northgate Foods corresponds to the parent customer account **Northgate Foods Group** (`A10004`), which rolls up six shipping site accounts (`A10007`, `A10008`, `A10009`, `A10010`, `A10011`, and `A10012`). Per company business rules, revenue belongs to the customer (the parent account of the shipping site).
2. **Revenue Calculation**: Revenue recognized in the period includes:
   - Invoices dated between July 1, 2026 and September 30, 2026: **$1,306,549.643894** (with CAD amounts converted at the monthly exchange rate from `ref_fx_rate`).
   - Less credit memos dated in Q3 2026: **-$8,284.380236**.
   - Plus canceled load fees billed to the customer dated in Q3 2026: **+$1,425.00**.
   - **Net Revenue**: **$1,299,690.263658** (or approximately **$1,299,690.26**).

ANSWER: 1299690.263658

SELECT
  h.load_id,
  h.shpr_acct_id,
  s.acct_nm as site_nm,
  p.acct_id as prnt_id,
  p.acct_nm as prnt_nm
FROM tms_load_hdr h
JOIN mdm_cust_acct s ON h.shpr_acct_id = s.acct_id
JOIN mdm_cust_acct p ON s.prnt_acct_id = p.acct_id
WHERE p.acct_id = 'A10004'
LIMIT 5

WITH inv AS (
  SELECT 
    i.load_id,
    i.inv_dt,
    i.inv_tot_amt,
    i.curr_cd,
    COALESCE(fx.fx_rt, 1.0) as fx_rt,
    i.inv_tot_amt * COALESCE(fx.fx_rt, 1.0) as amt_usd
  FROM bil_cust_inv i
  JOIN tms_load_hdr h ON i.load_id = h.load_id
  JOIN mdm_cust_acct s ON h.shpr_acct_id = s.acct_id
  LEFT JOIN ref_fx_rate fx 
    ON fx.from_curr_cd = i.curr_cd 
    AND fx.to_curr_cd = 'USD' 
    AND fx.eff_mo_dt = DATE_TRUNC(i.inv_dt, MONTH)
  WHERE s.prnt_acct_id = 'A10004'
    AND i.inv_dt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
),
cr AS (
  SELECT 
    c.load_id,
    c.cr_dt,
    c.cr_amt,
    c.curr_cd,
    COALESCE(fx.fx_rt, 1.0) as fx_rt,
    c.cr_amt * COALESCE(fx.fx_rt, 1.0) as amt_usd
  FROM bil_cr_memo c
  JOIN tms_load_hdr h ON c.load_id = h.load_id
  JOIN mdm_cust_acct s ON h.shpr_acct_id = s.acct_id
  LEFT JOIN ref_fx_rate fx 
    ON fx.from_curr_cd = c.curr_cd 
    AND fx.to_curr_cd = 'USD' 
    AND fx.eff_mo_dt = DATE_TRUNC(c.cr_dt, MONTH)
  WHERE s.prnt_acct_id = 'A10004'
    AND c.cr_dt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
),
canc AS (
  SELECT 
    f.load_id,
    f.fee_dt,
    f.cust_fee_amt,
    f.curr_cd,
    COALESCE(fx.fx_rt, 1.0) as fx_rt,
    f.cust_fee_amt * COALESCE(fx.fx_rt, 1.0) as amt_usd
  FROM bil_canc_fee f
  JOIN tms_load_hdr h ON f.load_id = h.load_id
  JOIN mdm_cust_acct s ON h.shpr_acct_id = s.acct_id
  LEFT JOIN ref_fx_rate fx 
    ON fx.from_curr_cd = f.curr_cd 
    AND fx.to_curr_cd = 'USD' 
    AND fx.eff_mo_dt = DATE_TRUNC(f.fee_dt, MONTH)
  WHERE s.prnt_acct_id = 'A10004'
    AND f.fee_dt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT SUM(amt_usd) FROM inv) as total_inv,
  (SELECT SUM(amt_usd) FROM cr) as total_cr,
  (SELECT SUM(amt_usd) FROM canc) as total_canc,
  (SELECT SUM(amt_usd) FROM inv) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amt_usd) FROM cr), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amt_usd) FROM canc), 0) as net_revenue

    load_id,
    arr_ts,
    tz_nm,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY load_id ORDER BY stop_seq DESC) as rn
  FROM tms_stop
  WHERE stop_typ_cd = 'DL'
),
delivered_loads AS (
  SELECT 
    h.load_id,
    h.carr_id,
    c.carr_nm,
    c.carr_typ_cd,
    DATE(s.arr_ts, s.tz_nm) as dlvr_dt
  FROM tms_load_hdr h
  JOIN tms_carr c ON h.carr_id = c.carr_id
  JOIN last_dl_stop s ON h.load_id = s.load_id AND s.rn = 1
  WHERE h.load_stat_cd = 'DLVD'
    AND (h.test_flg IS FALSE OR h.test_flg IS NULL)
    AND (h.void_flg IS FALSE OR h.void_flg IS NULL)
)
SELECT 
  carr_nm,
  carr_typ_cd,
  COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM delivered_loads
WHERE dlvr_dt BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY carr_nm, carr_typ_cd
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 10

all_rules.statement: A customer is a parent account. It rolls up to nothing, and it is neither a shipping site nor a bill-to party.
A load is delivered when the carrier on its final row reports the final delivery: status DLVD. A canceled load does not count as delivered.
A load can be invoiced only when a signed proof of delivery is on file. An unsigned document does not count.
Revenue and loads belong to the parent of the site that shipped.
A load is booked on its first tender: the row that does not point to an earlier row. A re-tender is not a second load.
A load is one shipment, counted once: it has exactly one first tender.
A re-tender points to exactly one earlier tender. That first row keeps status RTND and is never deleted.
A shipping site rolls up to exactly one parent account, which is its customer.
The account on a load is a shipping site, and the account that pays is a bill-to party. Neither is the customer.
Test loads are never billed.
A test load or a voided load is not a load.
